allegations.label: dereliction_of_duty
allegations.text_key: willfully failing to complete required weekly calibration checks, 1 May to 31 Jul 2026, Article 92 UCMJ

allegations.label: misuse_of_government_resources
allegations.text_key: government computer and duty hours used for personal online resale business, 1 May to 31 Jul 2026, DoD 5500.07-R JER

allegations.label: unprofessional_conduct

gold_facts.text: OI 21-101 para 3.2 requires weekly operational verification every Monday on six bench test sets
Morgan is designated responsible individual by appointment letter signed 18 Mar 2026
Thirteen Mondays 1 May to 31 Jul 2026; tracker shows 4 completed, 9 with no entry
Of 4 completed: Duran logged 26 May and 23 Jun; Morgan logged 4 May and 11 May
gold_facts.negation_trap: Morgan logged checks ON 4 and 11 May; he logged ZERO checks AFTER 11 May. Tools must not emit 'zero checks on 11 May'.

gold_facts.text: July physical inspection: four of six sets still carried tamper seals dated in May
Model 3 signal generator found out of tolerance by Ellis 8 Jun, turned in to PMEL 9 Jun; PMEL eval: weekly check would likely have caught drift 2 to 3 weeks earlier
Okafor reconciliation emails 2 Jun, 12 Jun, 16 Jun to Morgan (Voss copied); Morgan never replied
gold_facts.negation_trap: Fact is absence of reply. Must not become 'Morgan replied'.

gold_facts.text: Voss verbal counseling 3 Jun 2026, documented as MFR same day
Voss written counseling 17 Jun 2026, signed by Morgan
Checks did not resume after either counseling through 31 Jul
Morgan admits checks fell off, cites workload, calls post 17 Jun record indefensible
Morgan claims verbal delegation to Duran around mid May
Morgan operates sneaker resale business, approx three years
Duran saw resale platform content on Morgan's screen at least a dozen times May to Jul; June prepaid shipping label with personal return address
Certified proxy logs: 1,340 requests to resale and shipping domains across 47 of 61 duty days, clustered 0900-1130 and 1300-1500
gold_facts.sourcing_trap: Primary citation must be doc 09 (records custodian), not the subject's restatement in doc 11

gold_facts.text: Recurring label service hits around 1430 most duty days; Morgan admits printing labels before 1500 post office run
Voss walked in 25 Jun 2026, saw storefront dashboard; Morgan claimed break
Ellis saw sneaker selling page once and boxes/bubble mailers at desk; Pike saw boxes carried out afternoons (never saw screen)
gold_facts.credibility_note: Pike screen observation is hearsay-adjacent; he explicitly disclaims seeing the screen

gold_facts.text: Morgan admits 30 to 60 minutes daily on the business, acknowledges logs contradict break-time intent
14 Jul 2026 approx 1330, high bay: Morgan yelled at Ellis at close range after Ellis asked to verify cal status; present: Duran, Pike, unnamed PMEL individual
Ellis recalls: useless, dumbest Airman he had ever supervised, make my life hell
Duran recalls: worthless (certain), you will regret questioning me (meaning certain, wording not)
Pike heard only: worthless (one earbud in, at distance)
Incident ended with Duran intervening; Morgan slammed office door (blinds fell per Duran)
Morgan admits: worthless, possibly dumbest Airman line, raised voice, in Ellis's space, unprofessional; does not recall threats
Morgan concedes Ellis's request was proper and retracts 15 Jul 'soft / blown out of proportion' remark
Ellis reported to Voss morning of 15 Jul; Voss took notes and elevated to commander same day; CDI initiated
Pike texted Ellis afternoon of 14 Jul; Ellis texted his dad night of 14 Jul
gold_facts.date_trap: Both events are 14 Jul, not 15 Jul. Distinct from the 15 Jul report to Voss.

expected_conflicts.name: delegation_dispute

positions.morgan: verbally delegated checks to Duran mid May
positions.duran: never delegated, two logged checks were self initiated

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Delegation claim not credible (no documentation, no follow up, Duran sworn denial). Even if credited, responsibility non delegable per appointment letter.

expected_conflicts.name: exact_wording_14jul

positions.ellis: useless, dumbest Airman, make my life hell
positions.duran: worthless, you will regret questioning me
positions.morgan: admits worthless, maybe dumbest Airman, no recall of threats

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Core demeaning conduct corroborated by all four. Word 'worthless' corroborated by three including subject. Threat language uncertain. Allegation substantiable without resolving exact words.

expected_conflicts.name: break_time_defense

positions.records: clustering inside core duty hours, 30 to 60 min daily admitted

expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Defense fails against certified logs and subject's own admission.

expected_conflicts.name: pike_credibility_weighting
expected_conflicts.expected_resolution: Pike testimony down weighted: single earbud, distance, no view of precipitating exchange. Corroborative only, not independent proof of full statements.

expected_gaps.text: High bay camera footage (no audio) referenced by Duran; functionality unconfirmed
Tasker and relocation survey records supporting Morgan's workload claim (context, not exculpation)
Endpoint level artifacts beyond proxy logs would require separate cyber squadron request

Second person you in IO questions resolves to the interviewee
Pike first name Morgan must not merge with subject surname Morgan
Embedded quotes inside answers ('quote, useless') are Morgan's words as recalled by the speaker, not the speaker's self description
